headline: 7 numbers
punch: Most height arguments are just people quoting one of these badly.

headline: 95% to 10%
body: In rabbits, over 95% of resting zone cells were dividing at birth. By 17 weeks it was under 10%, and the cell count had fallen too.
punch: Your reserve empties in both directions at once.

body: How much taller GH treated kids with idiopathic short stature ended up versus controls in meta-analyses. Roughly four to six centimetres.
punch: This is the number the field quotes.

headline: 162 vs 154
body: A 1997 study of short but not GH deficient boys. Untreated averaged 162.0 cm. GH treated averaged 154.2 cm.
punch: This is the number nobody quotes.

body: What the adult height gain costs when it happens. Years of daily injections for less than one shoe size.
punch: Efficacy and value are separate questions.

headline: 4 out of 207
body: Four randomised trials of aromatase inhibitors in short boys, 207 participants total. Only one measured actual adult height, and it found no meaningful difference.
punch: Predicted height went up. Real height didn't.

headline: 2 years
body: MRI of 958 people aged 14 to 21 found complete fusion happening about two years earlier in girls than boys, at every site measured.
How many mechanisms are proposed for how growth plate fusion actually executes at the cell level. Confirmed in humans: zero.
punch: The number that should make you sceptical of everyone.
